stem:
The diagram shows Nidhi's magnetic compass resting flat on a wooden desk, away from other magnets. After the needle settles, she notes which tip points toward geographic north.

What has the settled needle helped her find?

options.text: North–south direction; the tip toward geographic north is the North-seeking pole.
North–south direction while the needle is still swinging.
A direction that a plain iron pin on the desk would show the same way.
East–west direction, because the red paint on that tip marks east.

teacher.key_rationale: A freely settling compass needle rests along north–south. The tip that points to geographic north is the North-seeking pole. Reading while swinging, treating a plain iron pin the same, or using paint colour alone are wrong.
teacher.figure_note: Rewrote IGCSE force-block tikz into a settled compass on a desk.
